claim: The human miR29-compatible target site is retained by the predominant observed coding-compatible PMP22 RNA structures, despite rare proximal cleavage calls.
context: PolyASite2 GRCh38 discovery, tested orthogonally in Glinos2022 GTEx v9 ONT/FLAIR processed models and raw assigned counts; not Schwann-cell transfer or a response mechanism.
baseline_model: Canonical terminal exon and dominant distal cleavage retain the site; natural proximal ends could remove it but annotation counts and broad genomic deletion are not usage evidence.
discovery_sources: Ensembl ENST00000312280.9 and terminal genomic sequence GRCh38
validation_sources: GTEx v9 Long Read Data flair_filter_transcripts.gtf.gz
GTEx v9 Long Read Data quantification_flair_filter.counts.txt.gz
prior_exposure: Inspected PolyASite target coordinates and atlas-wide average TPMs, not individual target library values. Dominant site17:15229780:- had average133.611 TPM; proximal sites15230714 and15230826 had0.0757 and0.1409. Inspected Glinos methods, pipeline selection and official file metadata but no target models/counts. Human canonical annotation and site sequence were inspected. No assertion of absent model prior knowledge. Independent assay test is conditional on processed-model validity.
prediction: Among libraries with at least10 assigned counts to coding-compatible PMP22 models, at least80 percent have at least95 percent of those counts assigned to models retaining the complete human miR29 8mer at GRCh38 chr17:15230233-15230240 inclusive, minus strand. Also report all PMP22-assigned models separately.
analysis_plan: Read GTF1-based closed exons, preserve model IDs and count tokens. Coding-compatible means containing the full canonical CDS genomic exon pieces in transcriptional order, not simply intersecting the gene. Site retention requires the full8mer in an exon. Do not assign gene-overlap unrelated transcripts. Primary threshold10 counts; sensitivity5 and20. At least5 eligible libraries from at least2 documented subjects or distinct independently prepared cell lines are needed for testing; repeats are not extra donors. Compute descriptive per-library fractions and donor-collapsed checks without inferential p-values. Source interpretation ambiguity or missing sample identities may leave biological replication unresolved even if a model-space arithmetic test is possible.
success_rule: At least80 percent of eligible libraries have retaining fraction>=0.95 with required coverage/identity. Label supported only within processed coding-compatible model space, not a natural-APA causal proof.
failure_rule: Adequate eligible data with fewer than80 percent passing rejects this proposed predominance threshold. Inadequate coverage, unidentified units or noninformative endpoint modeling leaves the locked test untestable, not confirmed. Missing models/filtered structures are not zero.
confounder_checks: FLAIR TSS and ORF filters select the transcript universe
Quantification uses models and does not guarantee each assigned read spans the target site
Human tissues/cell lines not purified Schwann cells
Source/sample overlap with PolyASite and repeated donors
selection_and_multiplicity: Single target/site hypothesis selected from prior mechanism and exploratory PolyASite inspection. No multiple-candidate significance tests. Any context subgroup after outcome inspection is exploratory; no reuse as untouched validation.
